gaps: No existing CLI or SDK wraps Kakao's transparency-report statistics; the data is only reachable through the privacy.kakao.com web page or manual XLSX downloads
The web page shows one half-year at a time; there is no whole-archive view of the 2012-present series
patterns: Google/Apple transparency dashboards expose period-over-period navigation; the prevYn/nextYn flags are Kakao's equivalent and should drive archive walking

novel_features.name: Whole-archive series
novel_features.description: One tidy table of every published half-year since 2012 — requests, processed, and affected accounts per service corporation and request category — instead of 28 separate report lookups.
novel_features.rationale: The web page and the raw endpoint show one half-year at a time; only a CLI that walks the whole archive in a single command can produce the longitudinal series researchers actually chart.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when a task needs trends over time (e.g. 'how did warrant volumes change since 2015') rather than a single period's numbers.

novel_features.name: Latest-report resolution
novel_features.description: Fetch the newest published half-year without knowing which period it is.
novel_features.rationale: The endpoint requires an exact year/half-year and answers out-of-range requests with an HTML page; the CLI probes backward from the current date and follows the API's own nextYn flag so agents never guess.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this as the first call whenever the task says 'current' or 'most recent' — it removes the guess-the-period failure mode.

novel_features.name: Workbook link index
novel_features.description: List the official XLSX workbook download URLs (Korean and English editions) for every published half-year.
novel_features.rationale: Each half-year's workbook URLs are buried in that period's JSON payload; the CLI collects them across the archive so a downstream job can mirror the primary sources.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when the deliverable needs the official source files (archival mirroring, citation) rather than the parsed numbers.

narrative.headline: Kakao's 2012-present government data-request statistics as one queryable archive — series, latest-report resolution, and workbook mirroring no other tool offers.
narrative.value_prop: Kakao publishes semiannual transparency reports (warrants, communication data, restriction measures for Kakao and Daum services) behind a one-period-at-a-time web page. This CLI turns that into an agent-friendly archive: `series` builds the full longitudinal table in one call, `latest` resolves the newest period without guessing, and `workbooks` indexes the official XLSX editions.

quickstart.comment: Verify connectivity — the API is public, no credentials needed
Resolve and fetch the newest published half-year
Build the 2012-present warrant series as CSV

troubleshoots.symptom: transparency returns 'response is not JSON' or an HTML page
troubleshoots.fix: The year/half-year is outside the published range (before 1H 2012 or after the latest report) — run `latest` to find the newest period, or `series` to see the full range.
-1 is the API's encoding for N/A (Kakao stopped providing that data type); the site renders it as N/A. Filter it out before summing.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI for questions about South Korean government requests for Kakao/Daum user data: warrant volumes, compliance trends, communication-data policy history. It is the fastest path to the full 2012-present series and to the official XLSX workbooks.
anti_triggers: Do not use it for Kakao's developer/business APIs (KakaoTalk messaging, Kakao Login, ad reports) — this wraps only the privacy transparency statistics
Do not use it for content-moderation or DSA-style statistics; Kakao's transparency report covers government data requests only
Do not sum numberOfAccounts across categories — categories overlap in what they count and -1 means N/A, not zero
